answer: Each agent may bid for a task only after staking tokens that are locked until its work passes an independently sampled audit. Auditors are selected from established participants and earn a fee for catching fabricated results, while a failed audit forfeits the bidder’s stake. This makes spawning identities alone unprofitable: a sybil operator must fund every account, produce verifiable work, and risk losing collateral on each failure. Even names like terrace, dawn, and lagoon cannot turn one wallet’s stake into many independent claims.
